description: This file defines a functional interface 'JmsExceptionThrowingBiConsumer' that extends 'BiConsumer' to operate on JMS Message objects and a generic type 'T', allowing for operations that may throw 'JMSException'. It also provides a static method to wrap such consumers into standard 'BiConsumer's with exception conversion to 'JMSRuntimeException'.

classes.name: JmsExceptionThrowingBiConsumer
classes.description: A functional interface similar to BiConsumer that accepts a JMS Message and a value of type T and may throw JMSException.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Performs an operation on the given JMS Message and value, potentially throwing JMSException.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Converts a JmsExceptionThrowingBiConsumer that throws JMSException into a standard BiConsumer that re-throws exceptions as JMSRuntimeException.
